dialogues.speaker: Troubled Telfair
dialogues.text: Well, I'm indulging myself a little with a few tasty restaurant treats.

dialogues.speaker: Troubled Telfair
dialogues.text: Even though I can only afford the cheapest ones...

dialogues.speaker: Troubled Telfair
dialogues.text: I should really save my spare Mora for my little brother and sister, who are still growing.
